faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Any student planning to study abroad — from bachelor's to PhD — can create a profile, upload documents, and explore scholarships that fit their background.
faq.a2: We compare your academic level, field, grades, and language results with each opportunity's requirements, then an advisor reviews the results with you.
faq.q3: Can an advisor help with my CV and motivation letter?
faq.a3: Yes. You can request CV preparation, motivation letter support, translation, and full application assistance directly from your dashboard.
faq.a4: Your documents are visible only to you and the EduBridge team assigned to your file, and are used solely to prepare your applications.

aboutUs.title: A graduation project built by four engineers-to-be
aboutUs.lead: We are four Computer Systems Engineering students at the University College of Science and Technology. EduBridge is our graduation project: a web platform that helps an educational consultancy office organise students, documents, scholarships and services in one place.
aboutUs.story: Students usually send their files and questions over WhatsApp, and advisors track everything by hand. We wanted to replace that with one clear workflow: students build their profile, upload documents once, discover suitable scholarships and follow every step, while advisors manage requests from a single CRM.
aboutUs.mission: Make the scholarship journey simpler for students and the daily work lighter for advisors — with technology that supports people, not replaces them.
